Beyond Missingness Rate:
Structured Stress Testing and Feature Contracts
for Passive Sensing Data
Code & reproduction
github.com/dansojo/ictc2026-missingness-stress-test
Tae Ho Kim | Independent Researcher sinzenight@gmail.com
1 Introduction
Passive sensing data collected by smartphones or wearables may contain
missing records due to device state or failures, or because participants do not
wear or use the devices. Even at the same missingness rate, sporadic losses
at multiple time points and losses over a continuous interval can distort
features calculated from the remaining records differently. Evaluating
missingness therefore requires considering both the missingness rate and the
pattern of missing records.
To examine this difference, this study removes the same number of originally
observed valid records either at random or from a continuous interval. It then
evaluates how much features of event count, state ratio, intensity, and timing
change relative to their values before removal. A “feature contract” specifies
how each feature is calculated, the observation conditions required for
calculation, and when calculation is withheld if those conditions are not met.
These contracts guide the evaluation of feature distortion under different
missingness patterns, while predictive model stability is evaluated separately.
2 Methods
4 Primary results
For the 10 participants in the ETRI passive sensing dataset, 10 days were
selected for each participant and measurement item, prioritizing dates with
higher observation availability. Ties were resolved by prioritizing dates with a
shorter longest continuous missing interval relative to the analysis window.
The initial setting for the number of selected days was retained. Across eight
measurement items, this yielded 800 participant–day–item combinations.
For contiguous missingness, an interval spanning 20% of each feature’s
analysis window was placed at a randomly selected starting position, and
records within that interval were removed. For random missingness, records
were removed at random from the same data, with the count matched to the
valid records actually removed by contiguous deletion. This was repeated 50
times for each participant–day–item combination.
Features of event count, state ratio, intensity, and timing were recalculated
under both conditions. The absolute difference from the value before removal
was divided by a fixed, pre-specified scale to obtain standardized error, and
errors were compared between conditions. The reference was the value
calculated from the originally observed records, not a true value that includes
unobserved records.

6 Conclusion and limitations
The effect of missingness pattern on feature distortion differed across feature
families, even when equal numbers of valid records were deleted. State ratio and
intensity showed higher error under contiguous than random deletion, but these
findings were insufficient to satisfy the overall decision criterion. The overall
decision therefore remained inconclusive. In ETRI prediction tests,
participant-level analysis did not establish that contiguous deletion affected
predictions more than random deletion.
This study analyzed data from 10 ETRI participants. The originally observed data
used as the reference may also have contained missing records; the comparison
was therefore not against a fully observed dataset. The two light-feature recovery
methods reduced error under contiguous loss but increased it under random loss.
These exploratory recovery experiments and external-data analyses alone do not
establish that recovery is effective in all settings, nor do they change the primary
verdict.
Source: final manuscript, Tables I and III, Fig. 1(a), and Sections IV-D and VI–VII. Repair values include random-loss results reported in text.

질문에 맞는 근거를 고르는 방법
대상·연도·쟁점이 하나의 적용 관계로 연결되어 있는지 함께 확인
적용 조건의 조합 오류를 설명하기 위한 예시입니다. 실제 법령 데이터는 아닙니다.
예시의 적용 관계
질문: 온라인 / 2025 / 업무 관련성
관계 A 온라인 / 2024 / 업무 관련성
관계 B 다른 대상 / 2025 / 업무 관련성
값을 따로 찾으면 잘못된 조합도 허용
조합을 함께 확인하면 해당 근거는 제외
대상에 ‘온라인’이 있고 연도에 ‘2025’가 있다는 사실만 따로 확인하면, 다른 대상의
2025년 자료까지 허용할 수 있습니다.
대상·연도·쟁점 조합(tuple)에 맞는 적용 관계(binding)를 찾고, 여기에 연결된
원문(parent)만 검색 후보로 허용합니다.
01 검색 대상 제한

중복을 제거해 상위 10건 선택
03 근거·인용 검증
